Technology description including backgro: EasyproofX® 1 is an internal water bar for fast, simple and reliable sealing of joints between two concrete sections. This internal water bar has a flexible, adherent coating on one side, which is covered with a granular material. As a result of the advantageous design of this rough surface, a stable and strong connection is guaranteed between the EasyproofX® 1 water bar and the surrounding concrete. The bonding characteristics of the flexible granular surface prevents the internal EasyproofX® 1 water bar from being infiltrated. The product is manufactured at Junghansring 52 in Rottenburg a. N. The slit strip is delivered to the production site and inserted into the sheet metal machine. The adhesive tape is clamped and glued to the inserted sheet, the granules and the overlap strip are applied. The metal waterstop is then packaged for transportation. | |
